name: Recurring Card Payment
definition: Specifies the attributes of a recurring card payment.

NumberOfPayments.name: Number Of Payments
NumberOfPayments.definition: Specifies the number of recurring payments.

Frequency.name: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Indicates the frequency of the recurring payment.

RegistrationReferenceNumber.name: Registration Reference Number
RegistrationReferenceNumber.definition: Reference number of the recurring payment agreement assigned by the merchant.

MaximumAmount.name: Maximum Amount
MaximumAmount.definition: Specifies the maximum amount for all recurring payments.

AgreementValidated.name: Agreement Validated
AgreementValidated.definition: Specifies whether the recurring payment agreement is validated or not.
